name: request-table
title: RequestTable
description: A network pane, as a preset of DataTable: the request columns (name, method, status, type, size, time), a waterfall on a shared time range, a playhead line that moves without re-rendering a row, links to the other end of a call, and two-line rows with a small waterfall when the table is narrow. Sorting, resizing, selection, the keyboard and virtual rows are DataTable's. Stays smooth at 10,000 rows.
